swarmPrompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a single square passive-skill icon for a MapleStory-style 2D cute monster game HUD. Hand-painted small game sprite illustration, slightly chunky clean pixel-art edges, strong dark outline, compact simple readable shapes, shaded saturated colors with restrained highlights, cohesive Korean MMORPG skill-icon style. Entire subject centered occupying 78% of square; generous transparent padding all around. Genuine transparent background. No typography, no letters, no digits, no UI panel, no border, no watermark. Readable at 48 pixels. Avoid photorealism, excessive detail, full scene, large fog or glow outside the silhouette. Three cute small purple monster heads grouped together: one front center and two smaller behind on either side, each with little horns and yellow eyes. Concept: more monsters, a monster swarm. Rich violet and lilac palette with bright eyes. Clear three-head silhouette.
